programme.desc: Maybach Exelero: ¡Un coche directamente de Gotham City! Realmente único en su género, con 700 caballos de potencia y 350 km/h de velocidad máxima.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Si sólo se ha sentado en la parte trasera de una gran limusina y si no sabe lo que son este tipo de limusinas, probablemente forme parte de la dirección. Cuando se trata de experiencia de conducción y rendimiento, es lógico que el asiento del conductor sea menos atractivo. Pero, de todos modos, eso sólo ocurre con los coches estatales más experimentados. El Audi RS y el Mercedes Clase S podrían incluso dejar sin trabajo a algunos chóferes.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Con la creación de su i8, el fabricante de automóviles muniqués BMW da un gran paso hacia el futuro. Al fin y al cabo, este coche de aspecto futurista es el primer deportivo alemán que utiliza tecnología híbrida. Supercars comprueba el BMW i8 en las calles de Los Ángeles. Pero BMW no sólo ha trabajado en el i8. También presentan el nuevo coupé deportivo 435i y el SUV deportivo X550d M.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: No siempre es la potencia pura de un coche lo que hace que la conducción en las curvas sea emocionante. El Subaru BRZ, con su motor bóxer bajo y su manejo bien equilibrado, da a su conductor una muy buena sensación para la carretera. El BMW 235i RS tiene un gran rendimiento en la rueda trasera y el Porsche Cayman GTS, con su motor central, pone una sonrisa en la cara en cuanto se pisa el acelerador.

programme.title: Chevrolet Camaro 50th
programme.desc: 50 años del Chevrolet Camaro. La marca americana lo celebra con un modelo especial de 453 CV. Probamos el coupé en las estribaciones de los Alpes.

programme.title: Ingeniería del Futuro
programme.desc: Las compañías navieras y los ingenieros crean nuevas máquinas para hacer que su industria sea más ecológica utilizando un recurso que ha movido al hombre a través de los océanos durante miles de años, el viento.

programme.title: Ingeniería del Futuro
programme.desc: El sol es la mayor fuente de energía en el sistema solar. Los innovadores buscan nuevas formas de capturar más energía del sol.

programme.title: Made In...
programme.desc: Jaguar y Land Rover están experimentando una transformación bajo el paraguas del grupo indio Tata. Jaguar se rejuvenece y Land Rover se amplía con nuevos modelos. Mostramos la cuerda floja entre tradición e innovación.

programme.title: Made In...
programme.desc: Dresde es el buque insignia del Grupo Volkswagen en materia de electromovilidad. En el corazón de la metrópolis del Elba se encuentra la Gläserne Manufaktur, una extraordinaria planta de producción para el e-Golf y el laboratorio del futuro de VW.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: En 2018, el Audi R8 Quattro Performance recibió una actualización. La nueva versión compartía algunas de sus características aerodinámicas con el Lamborghini Huracan. Además, el Porsche Macan S obtuvo un motor más potente.

programme.title: Porsche 911 Targa
programme.desc: Un descapotable con mucha potencia: el Porsche 911 Targa, el clásico de culto por excelencia.

programme.title: Porsche 911 Carrera S
programme.desc: Conducir un Porsche Carrera S en una pista de hielo gigante es el sueño de todo aficionado a los coches deportivos. Las ruedas traseras empiezan a girar y las comisuras de los labios parecen quedarse detrás de las orejas.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: El sintonizador de automóviles Lorinser cuenta con más de 30 años de experiencia en la puesta a punto de automóviles Mercedes Benz. También: Avión vs. Porsche GT3. Y: en un Aston Martin en el Nordschleife.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: El Salón del Automóvil de Essen es el evento para los amantes del automóvil y los deportes de motor. Más de 300.000 visitantes acuden aquí cada año y hacen hervir los salones sagrados.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: En el SEMA de Las Vegas, fabricantes y personalizadores presentan sus tesoros automovilísticos acabados a mano. Todos los grandes nombres de la escena se reúnen aquí.

programme.title: McLaren 570
programme.desc: McLaren se libera de la producción limitada y, con el 570S, lanza al mercado un nuevo modelo de entrada.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG C63 S Performmaster
programme.desc: Algunos clientes de automóviles aspiran a una mayor exclusividad que la que les proporciona el sintonizador del fabricante. La empresa alemana Performmaster ha mejorado el Mercedes C63 AMG S

programme.title: Jaguar XKR S
programme.desc: El Jaguar XK-RS descapotable con 550 CV es un británico con un temperamento ardiente.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Cada año 150.000 amantes del motor viajan al desierto de Navada para asistir al SEMA de Las Vegas, la más célebre exposición de automóviles tuneados del mundo. Entre ellos está la periodista Kati que se reúne con el experto en tuneo Dirk Hattenhauer, busca las últimas tendencias y conoce a algunas celebridades de este mundo, como el tuneador John D'Agostino y Ken Block.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: El SEMA Show de Las Vegas es la mayor y más conocida exposición de automóviles personalizados del mundo. Todo está presente, desde los coches de exhibición reconstruidos de forma compleja hasta los gigantescos 4x4. Y en la fiesta posterior al espectáculo “SEMA Ignited”, hacen que el asfalto se derrita.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: No hay nada más estimulante para Ola Stenegard, diseñador de motos BMW, que viajar por California. Allí conocerá a leyendas de fama mundial como el diseñador Ronald Sands o los customizadores Michel "Wooley" Woolaway y Alan Stulberg. El fanático de los Porsche Magnus Walker descubre su admiración por las motos personalizadas.

programme.title: Ford Mustang en la cima del Empire State Building
programme.desc: Con motivo del 50º aniversario del Mustang, Ford desmonta un modelo y lo lleva a un lugar insólito: la cima del Empire State Building. Allí, los mecánicos recomponen las piezas y presentan el modelo de aniversario del legendario pony car.

programme.title: La Historia de Lamborghini
programme.desc: En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini tenía un sueño: quería construir el mejor coche deportivo del mundo. A pocos kilómetros de la sede de Ferrari. Su primer coche, el 350 GT, dejó en la sombra cualquier comparación con sus competidores de Maranello.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.sub-title: Clasicos de coches de carreras alemanes
programme.desc: El Mercedes Silver Arrows es uno de los coches de carreras clásicos por excelencia. Acompañamos al piloto de carreras Jochen Mass por la carretera alpina de Grossglockner. Y además: el Porsche 550 RS Spyder supuso la base del éxito de la marca alemana en todo el mundo; en 1980, Audi causó sensación en el mundo del automóvil cuando presentó el Quattro con su tracción a las cuatro ruedas.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Facel Vega Facellia podrá ser un coche precioso pero las ambiciones de su fabricante se vieron frenadas por numerosas dificultades técnicas. Y además: el éxito del legendario Citroën 2CV comenzó con humildad; en la década de 1970, el Renault Alpine A110 cosechó grandes éxitos en los circuitos de rally; un reparador alemán devolvió a la carretera un clásico Bugatti Tipo 57.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.sub-title: Coches clasicos con traccion a las cuatro ruedas
programme.desc: El VW Type 166 Schwimmwagen es único y a la vez el auténtico todoterreno entre todos los de su clase. Y además: en los años 80, el Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 fue toda una sensación en el Campeonato Mundial de Rallyes; el Jeep Willys: el todoterreno de tierra entusiasmó a los fans del off-road de todo el mundo.

programme.title: Lancia Beta Montecarlo
programme.desc: Un pequeño biplaza italiano con motor central. El Lancia Beta Monte Carlo ofrece el placer de conducir coches clásicos a un precio de entrada bajo.

programme.title: BMW M3 E30
programme.desc: En 1986 nació una leyenda: el BMW M3, uno de los coches de carreras más exitosos de la historia. Se sentía en casa tanto en el deporte del motor como en la carretera. De 1987 a 1992, el M3 Turismo ganó el campeonato del DTM en dos ocasiones.

programme.title: Jochen Mass en el Mercedes flecha de plata W125
programme.desc: El Großglockner. Al pie de la carretera de los Alpes: coches de época. Se reúnen para el Gran Premio de Großglockner: 92 curvas y hasta un 11% de pendiente. El campo de salida consta de 75 vehículos, al igual que en la primera carrera de 1935.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Los superdeportivos italianos como el Ferrari "La Ferrari", el Lamborghini Aventador o el Pagani Huayra son los coches más bellos y rápidos del mundo, creados por los mejores diseñadores. Los superdeportivos italianos son sueños hechos realidad.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Los superdeportivos británicos como el Aston Martin Vanquish, el Bentley Continental GT Speed o el P1 de McLaren están entre los deportivos más espectaculares y bellos del mundo. No se trata sólo de potencia, sino también de gracia y estilo.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Ya sea el Porsche 918 Spyder, el Audi R8, el Mercedes AMG GT o el BMW i8, los superdeportivos alemanes son los más rápidos y codiciados del mundo, con sus impresionantes velocidades máximas y su increíble potencia de motor.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Los superdeportivos de Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Pagani y Porsche son como coches de carreras de Fórmula 1 para las calles, los coches más rápidos y emocionantes del mundo, cuya potencia y prestaciones parecen desafiar las leyes de la física.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Ya sea el Porsche 918 Spyder, el Mercedes Clase S, el BMW M6 o el Audi A8, los coches premium de Alemania definen el punto de referencia cuando se trata de confort, estatus, dinámica y placer de conducción.

programme.title: Porsche Macan Turbo RaceChip
programme.desc: El Porsche Macan ha sido un éxito de ventas desde su presentación en 2014. Es significativamente más compacto y dinámico que su hermano mayor, el Cayenne... y ahora con nosotros el Macan Turbo con una amplia actualización de rendimiento RaceChip.

programme.title: Porsche Techart Grand GT
programme.desc: Porsche es una marca que ha construido su propio mito y hace que los corazones de los entusiastas de los coches deportivos latan más rápido. El Techart Grand GT, fabricado por el preparador de la marca, es un Panamera muy mejorado.

programme.title: Corvette C7 Grand Sport
programme.desc: ¿Prefieres un motor turboalimentado o más bien uno atmosférico? Con la séptima generación del Chevrolet Corvette, los compradores pudieron elegir entre uno u otro. ¿Cuál es la variante de modelo más convincente, el Grand Sport o el Z06?

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Trofeo Histórico en el circuito de Nürburgring incluía coches clásicos de los deportes de motor. Y además: con el M3, BMW llevó la tecnología de los coches de carreras a las calles al ser un coche versátil, adecuado para la ciudad, el campo y la autopista; en 1987, el Ford Sierra RS Cosworth enseñó a sus competidores de carreras el significado del miedo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: 1964 significó la inmersión de Opel en el mercado de la clase de lujo y su ataque a Mercedes-Benz cuando la marca presentó su serie KAD con el Kapitän, Admiral y Diplomat, una gama de coches que ofrecía diseño americano emparejado con tecnología alemana. Echamos un vistazo a varios modelos de esta época.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.sub-title: Descapotables para un paseo por el campo
programme.desc: Muchos entusiastas de los coches consideran el 507 Roadster el BMW más bonito de todos los tiempos. Hoy en día, este deportivo de 1955 es uno de los clásicos más valiosos. Y además: en los años 50, Porsche sentó los cimientos de su icónica reputación con el 356 descapotable; los legendarios y únicos coupés y descapotables Borgward Isabella son un regalo para los amantes de los coches clásicos.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Mercedes-Benz 300SL con sus alas de gaviota es todo un icono de los coches clásicos. Acompañamos al propietario de un modelo recién restaurado en su primera carrera de coches clásicos de la Mille Miglia de Italia. Y además: otro competidor de la Mille Miglia fue el famoso coche burbuja BMW Isetta; justo después de su lanzamiento en 1954, el Jaguar D-Type casi gana la carrera de Le Mans.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: En 1967 la empresa química alemana Bayer desarrolló el Bayer K67, el primer automóvil con chasis de plástico. Y además: en 1954, el Mercedes Renntransporter transportaba los coches de carreras de la famosa marca desde el taller al recinto y viceversa, permitiendo tiempos de reparación más rápidos; uno de los coches técnicamente más avanzados de la década de 1910, el Type C de Audi.

programme.title: 50 años Ford Mustang
programme.desc: Modelo "Cutaway" para el 50 aniversario. Cómo el Ford Mustang acaba en la cima del Empire State Building.

programme.title: Pagani Huayra
programme.desc: Los superdeportivos italianos inspiran a jóvenes y mayores. Y en este fascinante mundo, el Pagani Huayra es la gloria que canta.

programme.title: Porsche Techart Grand GT
programme.desc: Porsche es una marca que ha construido su propio mito y hace que los corazones de los entusiastas de los coches deportivos latan más rápido. El Techart Grand GT, fabricado por el preparador de la marca, es un Panamera muy mejorado.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Desde el principio, AMG se ha fijado el objetivo de representar las máximas prestaciones automovilísticas, la exclusividad y el placer de conducción dinámico. Ya sea en el deporte del motor o en la carretera, AMG lleva más de 50 años marcando pautas.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Vehículos excepcionales y éxitos legendarios en el mundo del motor por un lado, golpes del destino y errores económicos por el otro. Pero el mito de Lancia sigue vivo.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: La división de automovilismo de BMW ha sido una historia de éxito desde su creación. Y no sólo en la pista. Los coches de carretera con la letra M en la parte trasera fascinan a todo el mundo y ganaron rápidamente una gran cantidad de seguidores.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Son elegantes, extravagantes y suecos: los coches de la marca de culto Saab. Desde el principio, Saab construyó coches diferentes: carrocerías individuales, tecnología innovadora, seguridad ejemplar. Mostramos el ascenso y la caída de la empresa.

programme.title: Historia carro
programme.desc: Buenos y fiables, americanos y vanguardistas: en los años 60 y 70, Ford construyó un clásico tras otro, y siempre con la fórmula Ford: tecnología sencilla, precio razonable. El Taunus, el Bath, el Escort y el Capri son hoy coches de culto.

programme.title: Mercedes 280E
programme.desc: La buena estrella en todas las carreteras. Un eslogan publicitario de Mercedes, que conecta mucho con este modelo. El modelo superior, que era conocido por la designación interna de la serie de producción "W 114": El Mercedes 280 E

programme.title: Maserati Ghibli
programme.desc: El Maserati Ghibli combina la elegancia italiana con unas prestaciones impresionantes.

programme.title: Sunbeam Tiger
programme.desc: El Sunbeam Tiger: un gran corazón V8 late en este delicado Roadster inglés.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Los descapotables británicos como el Jaguar F-Type, el Aston Martin V8 Vantage o el Bentley Continental son más elegantes y deportivos que muchos otros coches. Al fin y al cabo, los rápidos biplaza descapotables se inventaron en el Reino Unido.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Ya sea el Porsche 918 Spyder, el Audi R8, el Mercedes AMG GT o el BMW i8, los superdeportivos alemanes son los más rápidos y codiciados del mundo, con sus impresionantes velocidades máximas y su increíble potencia de motor.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Italia es el pais de la moda, el diseño y los coches más emocionantes del mundo. Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati y Alfa Romeo son considerados los epítomes de los coches impresionantes con formas impresionantes y motores vivaces.

programme.title: Dreamcars

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil once again exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge of committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live with the fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Joanna says her rage is scaring her son. Michelle’s rage has driven her to slap her child and hit her with a wooden spoon. Lisa admits to pulling her daughter’s hair when she gets angry. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These moms are sick and tired of living a lie. One mom fears her secret addiction to pain killers will tear her family apart. She asks Dr. Phil to help her get off the drugs before she loses everything, including her unborn child! Also, a grandmother who steals everything from steaks to ceiling fans. She says she knows it’s wrong and wants to stop, but is she really just afraid of getting caught? Plus, a mother confesses to her daughter a secret she has been carrying for 29 years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Being a single mother is hard enough, but imagine juggling soccer practice, PTA meetings and homework ... all while trying to cover up a secret life. Susan is a single mom with two kids who works as a prostitute to pay the bills. She says she's never had a real job and is addicted to the money she makes as an escort. Can Susan ditch her dangerous job and turn her life around? Then, Stephanie is a single mother of four and has been hiding a secret for 12 years. She's addicted to painkillers and takes up to 60 times the recommended dosage just to make it through the day. Fearing for their lives and those of their children, the women turn to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Their job is to protect you. They won't let you walk down the street alone. They call your house five times a day, screen your calls, monitor your every move. No, it's not the government or the F.B.I., it's mothers! Is there such a thing as a mom having too much love for her child? Dr. Phil puts Mom to the test!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A stay-at-home mother says she can't control her rage, and she takes it out on her kids. Dr. Phil intervenes for the sake of her five precious children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some moms don't want to grow up, and others don't want to grow old. Dr. Phil talks to women walking on the wild side and tries to rein them back in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After a Tennessee mother caused an international uproar when she sent her 7-year-old adopted son on a one-way flight back to Russia, the subject of international adoptions is making front-page headlines. Dr. Phil speaks with moms who say they relate to the Tennessee woman, and unless you walk a mile in their shoes, you have no way of understanding. Jane says she had no idea her 2-year-old daughter, Mikhaela, was profoundly deaf and autistic when she adopted her from the Ukraine eight years ago. Jane says the 10-year-old has multiple behavioral disorders and kicks, bites, punches and tries to hurt herself daily, and is getting too strong for her to handle. And, Kristi says all the love in the world couldn’t have helped the baby girl she adopted from China. Kristi says she wasn’t even close to being qualified to parent her now 14-year-old daughter, Tierney, who lives in a behavioral foster home in order to keep Kristi’s other children safe. If you’re thinking of adopting internationally, or if you’re an adoptive parent in crisis, don’t miss today’s show. Learn how to prepare for a cross-cultural adoption, how to get through the adoption process the correct way and what the experts have to say.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica, a mom of five, sent Dr. Phil a home video so disturbing it brought his wife, Robin, and many audience members to tears. Jessica admits that she’s angry all the time and says she struggles to parent her 7-year-old adopted son, Kristoff. She says she screams at the boy, puts hot sauce in his mouth and places him in a cold shower when he acts up. Attorney and child advocate Areva Martin weighs in. Then, several irate women in the audience give Jessica a piece of their mind.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Mom Tried To Kill Autistic Child (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Driven To Try And Kill Her Child? (Pt. 2)
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Moms are accused of bullying their own children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Who will Brad choose: his wife or girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, viewers met 21-year-old Bailey who says she has the greatest love story of the century. She says she met Jasmine on social media eight months ago and that it was love at first post. She says they’ve been communicating day and night but have never spoken on the phone and have never met. When Dr. Phil first tried to talk to Bailey, she became insistent that her mother, Ericka, not participate in the show, and Bailey angrily walked off the stage. Bailey decided to come back to tell Dr. Phil she wants to meet Jasmine for the first time because she has something important to tell her. Will Dr. Phil allow Bailey to meet the target of her obsession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Baronica and Nathan say that on July 10, 2021, their then 9-year-old son shot his 8-year-old brother in the chest with one of six unsecured guns in their home. The parents bravely come forward to tell their story in hopes that other parents will learn from their mistakes. Then, Kristin says the last time she saw her 15-year-old son, Ethan, he was heading to his best friend’s house. Within hours, she was informed Ethan had been killed by an unsecured gun in his best friend’s house. Kristin has fought to have Ethan’s Law enacted in CT, which ensures that parents are held accountable for the safe storage of their weapons. And, hear from Susan, whose daughter Amanda was sitting on a park bench when she was shot by a group of young people, leaving her paralyzed. Plus, Ryan Busse, a former gun industry executive who says he left the industry after seeing how fear tactics were being used to sell guns, joins the conversation. This is a show every parent needs to watch -- whether you own a firearm or not.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: t’s been almost four months since 5-year-old Summer Wells vanished from her home in rural Tennessee on June 15, 2021. Her parents, Don and Candus, say they believe their daughter was abducted. But, the couple say online bullies have accused them of having something to do with Summer’s disappearance. Don and Candus agreed to sit down with body language experts Scott Rouse and Greg Hartley, interrogators who have worked with the FBI, law enforcement and the military and have been referred to as a human lie detector, in hopes of clearing their name. Find out what the men think and if Dr. Phil agrees with their findings.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom is supposed to love and nurture her children, but what if she's too involved? Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling, manipulative and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration, not mourning. He claims she uses bribes to control his every move, including offering him $20,000 to divorce his first wife. Margaret admits that she can be pushy and difficult but says she just wants to see her son succeed in life. Is she really setting him up for failure? Does Reed really want to man-up and break free from his mother's grasp? And, is Margaret willing to let him go? Then, 35-year-old Anthony, star of the new TLC reality show Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home and letting his mom, Patti, wait on him hand and foot. How does Patti feel about their living arrangement? Will she ever kick Anthony out? Plus, hear how Anthony's lifestyle affects his dating life. If you know of a mother-son bond that's a little too close for comfort, don't miss this Dr. Phil. Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration. Margaret says she wants to see her son succeed - but is she setting him up for failure? Plus, 35-year-old Anthony, star of TLC's Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pedophiles once lurked in parks and around schoolyards, and then they prowled the playground of the World Wide Web. Now these predators have a more sinister method at their fingertips sending explicit text messages directly to your child's cell phone. Dr. Phil examines the latest technological threats to your kids and shows you how to protect them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: "Let me take a moment to read a few lines of a heartbreaking letter of a 10-year-old boy caught in the middle of an ugly, ugly custody battle between his parents" Dr. Phil says. Question for dad: Mom says she still loves you and misses you. Do you still love her? Put a check in one of the boxes: yes or no.”

Find out what's behind Dori's need to spoil Parker. Then, Joan says her 14-year-old daughter, Jacquie, is a snob, and her need for trendy clothes is turning her into a materialistic monster. Plus, Lauren spends her entire paycheck shopping, but with no money in her checking account, she’s afraid she could be headed for trouble. Barry says they walk on eggshells, waiting for Brandon’s next violent outburst and that every day he leaves the house worried that his wife may not be alive when he returns. programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Las aventuras de los bebés llorones Lágrimas mágicas
programme.desc: Los Bebés Llorones viven en el mundo de Lágrimas Mágicas donde aprenden juntos lo que es la amistad, el trabajo en equipo y la empatía. Disfruta con ellos aventuras increíbles en mundos llenos de magia. Cada uno de los Bebés Llorones es único, pero todos tienen algo en común: ¡sus lágrimas son mágicas!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Talking Hank esta entusiasmado por su primer dia de trabajo como guardia de seguridad durante la Noche de los Nerditos que se lleva a cabo en la ciudad, pero el trabajo no esta tan repleto de accion como el esperaba.

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre cómo las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: Boom and Reds
programme.desc: Boom & Reds, una serie preescolar. Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing

programme.title: Les Cueilleurs
programme.desc: À Rivière-Saint-Jean, Alex Beaudin et Alexis Parisée préparent leur motoneige pour une expédition en forêt. Sur la Côte-Nord, par une température de -17, les deux amis d'enfance vont ramasser le poivre des dunes. Cette épice particulière s'utilise aussi bien avec les viandes que dans du gin ou de la bière.

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.desc: Every episode offers a different journey! Xavier Petit, cameraman reporter, invites us to explore a country, a town, a people and, of course, a traditional market and a local speciality.

programme.title: À travers champs S03
programme.sub-title: A travers champs S03 - L'esprit de communaute
programme.desc: "L'esprit de communauté a toujours été important en agriculture. Il est encore bien vivant aujourd'hui, notamment chez la nouvelle génération qui privilégie un modèle d'agriculture où l'on mise davantage sur la coopération que la compétition."

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S07

programme.title: Les Cueilleurs

programme.title: Moogly: Embellishments for Your Crochet
programme.desc: Additions and embellishments for your crochet projects

programme.title: Arm Knitting: Twisted Stitch
programme.desc: Learn twisted stitch with Mary Beth!

programme.title: Knitting Stitch Along: Aran Braid Stitch
programme.desc: Learn how to make an aran braid stitch with Karyn Newbill in this Stitch Along video.

programme.title: Stitch Heaven: Interview with Dr. Anna Walden
programme.desc: Learn the secret meanings of colors with Dr. Anna Walden, PHD!

programme.title: Knitting Stitch Along: Florentine Freeze
programme.desc: Follow with Cheryl as she teaches this easy tutorial on how to make the Florentine Freeze pattern in your knitting.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cabinet Project Tour
programme.desc: A quick Whisper Mini tour of my recent 6-panel cabinet project.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 2
programme.desc: In part two of our three-part series, Aaron shows us how to make the frame parts for the top of our lid. Now these videos do assume that you’ve opened the program and have a little familiarity with the tools.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Criss-Cross Table
programme.desc: The base of this large table features a criss-cross design that does away with two of the aprons you'd find in a typical table base. I honestly wasn't sure if it would work and the only way to find out was to build one.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cleaning Blades & Bits
programme.desc: If you find that your blades and bits just aren't performing like they used to, you might not need to send them out for a sharpening. They might just be in desperate need of a good cleaning.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Krylon Spray Stain
programme.desc: Krylon recently released a line of exterior wood stains in spray form. A very convenient way to transfer color to your outdoor projects! I sprayed 6 different test boards (maple and white oak) just to see how well the stain applies.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Filament Rack - For 3D Printing
programme.desc: A wall-mounted rack to store your 3D filament.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - Tablesaw Experience
programme.desc: Whenever I have a new student in the shop, I try to convey what if feels like when something is going wrong on the tablesaw. This may seem like an abstract idea, but knowing how to identify a problem before it goes too far could give you that extra second or two you need to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 9
programme.desc: I glue the back panel strips to the shelves, add an extra ebony adornment with a slot-cutting bit, and give a relatively lengthy tutorial on chopping the resulting mortise nice and square. I finish up by creating the ebony strips for the front of the top and bottom case pieces and then I finally glue the case together.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Property Search and a Bad Surprise
programme.desc: Looking for a new property with a shop in Missouri.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Convertible Bench
programme.desc: This Convertible Bench is designed for versatility and style. Each section has two positions allowing for numerous configurations. It's a bench, a 2-seat bench, a table, a love seat, and even a chair with an end table, all in one piece of furniture!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: SketchUp Basics - Trunk Lid Part 3
programme.desc: In the final part of our series, Aaron puts the finishing touches on the trunk lid. If this is your first experience with SketchUp, I highly recommend checking out the tutorials located at Sketch Up For Woodworkers

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: My New BIG Assembly Table
programme.desc: This large assembly table is a great inexpensive alternative to the long and cumbersome process of building a torsion box.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Build an Arts & Crafts Table
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to finish up your arts & crafts table so it will serve you for a long long time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Carbon Method Update
programme.desc: An update on the effectiveness of Carbon Method's Carbon Coat product for rust prevention in a humid climate.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: DIY Refinishing
programme.desc: The pain of refinishing isn't that bad when you're learning with Marc! Follow the master woodworker as he refinishes his projects and teaches you a couple of his secrets.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Space-Saving Plywood Cart
programme.desc: A compact plywood cart that saves space and organize full sheets and scraps.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rocking Horse Part 2
programme.desc: The second and final video in this series covers finishing and assembly. As with any project, you should always ask yourself if it might be better to pre-finish the parts. Since the rocking horse would be incredibly difficult to finish after assembly and all of our parts are screwed together, pre-finishing was a no-brainer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cutting Board Disaster
programme.desc: A few months ago, I woke up one morning, poured my coffee, and was incredibly disappointed to see that my cutting board exploded!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Coping Cabana
programme.desc: This is just a quick (silly) video of me assembling an Eagle America coping sled. I find this type of sled is not only helpful, but a necessity, when making frames and raised panel doors. It’s a great jig for running those narrow pieces through a big router bit.

programme.desc: Detailing a dress with The Crafty Chica

programme.title: FaveCrafts: Candy Drawer DIY Party Favor
programme.desc: This cute Candy Drawer DIY Party Favor is an excellent, customizable DIY favor for just about any occasion. Fill the tiny drawer with candy and leave them on tables as a DIY wedding favor, or fill them with kind notes and hand out to your friends the next time you host girls' night. No matter what you use it for, this free paper craft idea is a great little project! Check out this video tutorial to learn how to make them.

programme.title: FaveCrafts: Vintage Plate DIY Cake Stand
programme.desc: Learn how to make a beautiful vintage plate cake stand.

programme.title: FaveCrafts: How to Use the Sizzix Twist and Style Tool
programme.desc: Ready to start making perfect flower stems and friendship bracelets? This How to Use the Sizzix Twist and Style Tool guide shows you just how easy using this tool is. Plus, this is a great tool you can use for all different kinds of crafts that require a little extra twist. Whether you are making flowers and need a stem, or you are working with wire on some DIY jewelry projects, this tool can become your go to! This Sizzix tool is worth giving a try if you want to expand your craft tools collection!

programme.desc: The Final Day Weigh‑In delivers dramatic moments from Lake Martin as championship bags hit the scale, crowning the Lippert Bassmaster Elite winner before fans at Wind Creek State Park in Alexander City.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Cook
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Drew Cook (‪@thecutlinetv‬) has been a strong competitor since joining the Elite Series in 2019, but a win has eluded him early in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. The former College Champion and current Elite Series rookie led wire to wire and got his first blue trophy in just his 3rd event of the season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, Przekurat becomes the youngest Elite Series champion and also breaks 100 pounds for the first time in history for a smallmouth bass event. Watch his week unfold in Clayton, NY.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley

Watch Mosley put four great days together on his way to his first Elite Series title at the 2023 Folds of Honor Bassmaster Elite at the Sabine River and take home the Marathon Peak Performance!

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Crews

programme.desc: Control is not the first word that comes to mind when thinking of modern quilting, but there are some techniques that can benefit by keeping things under control. programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.sub-title: Nature-Inspired Crafts: Wooden Rope Seat & Slab Wood Coffee Table
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.
